headline: NOBODY EXPECTS
ticker: DIPLOMATIC INCIDENT AT CAREERCRASH.ORG/INCIDENT: LIKE YOUR COUNTRY, WATCH IT FIGHT
SUMMIT AGREES TO MEET AGAIN TO DISAGREE AGAIN

guest.name: Sir Nigel Queueworth
guest.role: Delegate for England · queueing since Tuesday

beats.text: Tonight: forty countries meet at the summit to agree on absolutely nothing.
Delegates say the talks are going well, apart from the shouting, the chairs, and the buffet.
Well, I certainly didn't expect a Diplomatic Incident.
Our chief weapon is surprise. Surprise and queueing. Our TWO chief weapons are surprise, queueing, and a fanatical devotion to the orderly queue.
Sir Nigel, you are live on Broken News.
Amongst our weapons are such diverse elements as surprise, queueing, a sincere apology and a nice cup of tea. I'll come in again.
NOBODY expects the Diplomatic Incident! Fetch... THE COMFY CHAIR!
That is NOT. A COMFY. CHAIR.

realStory.text: Made up. Diplomatic Incident is real, though: forty countries brawl nonstop at careercrash.org/incident, and your likes make your country's delegate stronger. The sketch is Monty Python's Spanish Inquisition (1970). No cushions were harmed.
